title: Corvan Grain: October sea shipments down 62% on last year

facts.subject: Corvan Grain sea shipments
facts.statement: Corvan Grain reports that its sea shipments of wheat and maize in October 2026 were 62% below the same month a year earlier.

source_ref.text_snippet: Corvan Grain reports that its sea shipments of wheat and maize in October 2026 were 62% below the same month a year earlier.

facts.subject: Corridor Agreement
facts.statement: The fall follows the end of the Corridor Agreement on 10 September.

source_ref.text_snippet: The fall follows the end of the Corridor Agreement on 10 September.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port strike
facts.statement: The fall follows the strike at Orvan Grain Port that began on 14 September.

source_ref.text_snippet: The fall follows the end of the Corridor Agreement on 10 September and the strike at Orvan Grain Port that began on 14 September.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: The company has moved some cargoes to the Ravik Rail Link and to road haulage.

source_ref.text_snippet: The company has moved some cargoes to the Ravik Rail Link and to road haulage.

facts.subject: Shipping disruptions
facts.statement: The company has not changed its contracts with Midgard or Tolan buyers, and it says it is honouring them where shipping allows.

source_ref.text_snippet: The company has not changed its contracts with Midgard or Tolan buyers, and it says it is honouring them where shipping allows.

facts.subject: Rail alternative
facts.statement: The firm will not give a forecast for the first quarter.

source_ref.text_snippet: The firm will not give a forecast for the first quarter.

facts.subject: Shipping delays
facts.statement: It has also warned that the rail alternative is expensive and that some cargoes will arrive late.

source_ref.text_snippet: It has also warned that the rail alternative is expensive and that some cargoes will arrive late.
